title: Median minutes below a saturation of 90 in the first half hour

statement.cohort: Every anaesthetic of a child, leaving out test patients.
statement.outcome: The minutes between ten and forty minutes after the start during which the saturation lay below 90 per cent.
statement.result: One row with the median of those minutes over the anaesthetics that had a saturation reading in the window.

decisions.choice: below 90 per cent at every age
decisions.decision: The threshold is a saturation below 90 per cent, the same at every age.

decisions.choice: ten to forty minutes after the start
decisions.decision: The window runs from ten to forty minutes after the start of the anaesthetic.

question_sql:
WITH measured AS (SELECT h.anaesthetic_key, h.minutes_beyond FROM hypoxaemia_burden h WHERE h.minutes_beyond IS NOT NULL)
SELECT DISTINCT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.minutes_beyond) OVER () AS median_minutes_below_90 FROM measured m
note: The median is over anaesthetics with at least one saturation reading in the window; those with none are left out rather than counted as zero.
